postconditions.description: The integer k is a valid index in the string s.
The length of the string s is equal to l.
The length of the string s is between 3 and 5000.

postconditions.expression: Vasya can uniquely determine the value of k by asking for the first letter and then opening one more letter.
postconditions.description: Vasya's strategy allows him to win with a probability of 1 if he plays optimally.

postconditions.expression: Vasya cannot uniquely determine the value of k if there are at least two cyclic shifts of s that fit the information he knows.
postconditions.description: Vasya loses if there are multiple possible values of k.
